name: Ainembabazi Emmanuel
title: Managing Director & Professional Project Management Specialist
highlight: Project management specialist with over a decade experience in Uganda's transport infrastructure sector.
bio: Ainembabazi Emmanuel is a Professional Project Management Specialist and infrastructure development professional with over a decade of experience in Uganda's engineering and transport infrastructure sector.

He began his career in 2014 with Centre for Infrastructure Consulting Ltd (CIC) as Projects Coordinator, overseeing the coordination of the Jinja Nile Bridge construction project and subsequently supporting the design and supervision of several bridge projects across Uganda.

In 2019, he joined Korea Expressway Corporation as Business Development Manager – Uganda, serving as Branch Manager and Project Director for the Development of the Expressway Master Plan for Uganda. His responsibilities included project management, finance and administration, taxation oversight, stakeholder engagement and conflict resolution.
He has worked with leading international engineering and infrastructure organizations including Korea Expressway Corporation, Kyong Dong Engineering and Dohwa Engineering, among others.

He is the Founder and Managing Director of Proxy Consultants Ltd, where he leads the company's infrastructure consultancy and project management services, while facilitating collaboration between local and international expertise.

name: Christopher Job Mukuye
title: Transportation Engineer
summary: Professional transportation and civil engineer specializing in the planning and modeling of sustainable transportation systems and the design and construction supervision of highways and railway lines.
highlight: Multilingual transportation engineer with over 15 years of experience in traffic modeling, surveys and road design.
bio: His career spans transport systems research, traffic engineering and the management of complex, multidisciplinary transportation studies and highway supervision projects, mostly in Uganda, with earlier work in Japan, Rwanda and Ghana.

On the Expressway Development Master Plan for Uganda, he served as Assistant Project Manager for the national consultant, as Deputy Team Leader of the nationwide traffic surveys (OD surveys at 172 locations and counts at 146 stations, with more than 100 enumerators) and as Assistant Traffic Modeler, building the base traffic model in EMME. He went on to help develop Uganda's integrated expressway manuals with Korea Expressway Corporation, preparing the traffic, road safety and expressway planning guidelines.

He co-authored Volume VII (Non-Motorized Transport) of the Uganda Road Design Manual and helped produce Uganda's first Non-Motorized Transport Manual for the Ministry of Works and Transport. He currently serves as Traffic Engineer on the feasibility study and detailed design for the capacity improvement of the 30 km Namungoona–Nansana–Wakiso–Kakiri Road, and as Transport/Infrastructure Engineer on the integrated climate-resilient plan for the Royal Mile – Lubiri Cultural and Heritage Centre.
He is fluent in English and Luganda and has a working knowledge of Japanese.
